versions.content: LdCom: only Transformer output and UINT8_N or UINT8_DYN supported Only if • the data type of the ISignal is either UINT8_N or UINT8_DYN • or the ISignal has a reference to the DataTransformation in the role data- Transformation and the LdCom module is present, this ISignal shall be handled by LdCom.
